themes.name: Release and deployment reliability
themes.summary: The team reported that the deployment pipeline remained stable across all releases during the sprint.

themes.name: Collaboration and pairing
themes.summary: Pair programming was cited as helping the team complete the API migration more quickly.

themes.name: Code review responsiveness
themes.summary: Pull request reviews experienced multi-day idle periods; the team suggested a first-response target for reviews.

themes.name: Sprint readiness and acceptance criteria
themes.summary: Stories entered the sprint without clear acceptance criteria; the team proposed a readiness checklist before sprint entry.

strengths.summary: The deployment pipeline was stable across all releases.
Pair programming helped the team finish the API migration faster.

concerns.summary: Code reviews sat idle for days before anyone responded.
Two stories entered the sprint without clear acceptance criteria.

opportunities.summary: Define a first-response target for pull request reviews.
Add a readiness checklist before stories enter the sprint.

suggestedActions.title: Adopt a 4-hour PR first-response target
suggestedActions.reason: Define a team norm for first review comment or approval within 4 business hours; addresses idle reviews (FB-0003, FB-0005).

suggestedActions.title: Require acceptance criteria before sprint commitment
suggestedActions.reason: Sprint-readiness checklist gate before stories enter the sprint (FB-0004, FB-0006).

suggestedActions.title: Run a post-deploy smoke test checklist
suggestedActions.reason: Short post-deploy smoke tests after releases to sustain deployment reliability (FB-0001).

suggestedActions.title: Schedule weekly pairing blocks for knowledge sharing
suggestedActions.reason: Regular pairing slots to extend a practice the team found effective (FB-0002).

limitations: Suggested actions require human review before approval.
Analysis identifies process patterns, not individuals.
Observations are not proof of causality.
